audit_items.proof_trace: Go map iteration at line 79 produces randomized (unsorted) cellIndices, violating the c-kzg-4844 library's requirement for sorted indices. The KZG recovery algorithm requires positional correspondence between indices and cells; random ordering causes incorrect cell/proof recovery. No sorting is applied before calling RecoverCellsAndKZGProofs at line 86.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends valid data column sidecars via P2P. When the node attempts reconstruction with ≥50% columns, the map iteration produces unsorted cellIndices with high probability, causing KZG recovery to return cryptographically incorrect cells and proofs that differ from the original blob's cells/proofs.
